lines.say: You're not bad at maths. You're practising it wrong.
You understood the method on Tuesday. By the exam, it's gone.
Because you did the same type, back to back.
It feels like learning. It's just repeating.
Then the exam mixes everything, and you can't tell which method to use.
So mix your sets. Old questions next to new ones.
And when you miss a day, Offload reschedules the week.
Comment mix and I'll send you the method.
